legend: Histology of the various tissue layers of the upper eyelid.

Basal cell carcinoma. A,B Axial and sagittal T1-weighted postcontrast MRI shows tumour involving the left eyelid and periorbital soft tissues with ulceration in the medial canthal region, left nose, and premaxillary soft tissues extending inferior to the globe (white arrows). Enhancing tumour is present posterior to and indenting upon the globe (black arrows).

Squamous cell carcinoma. A Coronal T1-weighted postcontrast MRI shows enhancing tumour in the soft tissues of the left forehead and brow (arrows). B Axial T1-weighted postcontrast MRI shows tumour extending from the brow and eyelid into the superior orbit through the supraorbital foramen (arrows). C Coronal T1-weighted postcontrast MRI shows tumour in the superior left orbit spreading along the ophthalmic nerve (arrow).
